scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach(f=>fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.rmSync(f,{force:true})); const ua=(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''); if(!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names API,MOBILE --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "cd artifacts/api-server && pnpm run dev" "cd artifacts/mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm run dev:local"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:ci: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/mobile" --filter "./artifacts/api-server" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
